instruction: Compile all text from the Impress presentation slides into a Word document and save it as "extracted.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint to Word document. Evaluator verifies comprehensive extraction through multiple checks: (1) Presence of 10 representative texts across the entire presentation: beginning (Unlocking the Power of ChatGPT, Introduction, What is ChatGPT), middle (Crafting Effective Prompts, Be Specific, Ask Direct Questions, Use Punctuation and Grammar, Experiment and Iterate), and end (Conclusion, Thank You), (2) Word count >= 50 to ensure body text extraction, (3) Character count >= 250 for meaningful content. All checks must pass for full score, ensuring truly comprehensive text extraction.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses multi-layered verification approach: (1) checks presence of 10 representative texts spanning entire presentation (beginning/middle/end), (2) requires word count >= 50 to prevent extraction of only titles, (3) requires character count >= 250 for meaningful content
The three-part verification significantly strengthens coverage - an agent cannot pass by extracting only the 10 specific strings, as this would fail the word/character count thresholds
Getter logic is correct: properly extracts full document text, checks text presence case-insensitively, and calculates word/character counts
Metric logic is correct: verifies all three conditions and provides appropriate partial credit (0.5) if texts present but content insufficient
Postconfig is appropriate: activates document window and saves file to ensure getter can read the final state

Minor semantic gap: Instruction says 'all text' but evaluator uses heuristic thresholds (50 words, 250 chars) rather than true completeness verification. However, for a presentation with 10 titled sections, these thresholds are reasonable proxies for comprehensive extraction
Practical feasibility: The evaluator can realistically verify the task was completed with substantial comprehensiveness, though not absolute completeness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing thresholds if source presentation is known to be longer (e.g., word count >= 100 for presentations with substantial body text)
Alternative: Add instruction clarification like 'Extract all text content from the Impress presentation slides' to acknowledge the heuristic-based verification approach
